spoken_answer: This red edge shows Porz and Bruce, 2022, refuting dendrite suppression above 0.8 milliamps per square centimetre. Lithium nucleates inside microscopic grain-boundary flaws, whatever the bulk shear modulus. Notice the dashed gap below it: sub-1 MPa pulse annealing remains completely untested.
